title: Tripartite Counterattack
base_prompt:
Fully animated cinematic stylized-realistic 3D CGI feature-film shot, continuous motion, expressive character animation and acting, believable fur and cloth simulation, detailed wet stone and metal, dynamic ocean, rain, spray, steam and sparks, cinematic lighting, anamorphic 16:9 widescreen, 24 fps.
Setting: the narrow curved iron-and-stone catwalk with a rusted iron railing circling the brass lantern room at the top of a weathered cliffside stone lighthouse, high above a rocky ocean and sea spray. Time and weather: night, violent storm, slate-blue and grey palette, driving rain, lightning flashes.
Characters (keep exactly on-model): the masked hero, a lean athletic acrobat in a rain-soaked, storm-grey and signal-orange weatherproof bodysuit with reflective silver safety-tape chevrons across the chest and limbs, a smooth brass-rimmed diving-style mask-helmet with two round amber lantern-glass eye lenses that narrow and widen expressively, a climbing harness, and brass winch gauntlets on both wrists that fire braided orange grapple cables tipped with small folding hooks; Penny, a fourteen-year-old girl with windblown auburn curls under a patterned headscarf, freckles, a heavy canvas mechanic's apron full of wrenches, pliers and gears, and a grease-stained linen rag; clever, practical, young-looking; Tomkin, a compact, stout ginger-and-white tabby cat walking upright, wearing a thick ribbed grey wool sock folded over his ears like a baker's toque, a lavender silk boxer-shorts cape fastened at the neck with a brass safety pin, wielding a bent stainless-steel soup ladle like a rapier and carrying a yellow plastic butter tub; expressive, brave and comically self-important; a gunmetal-grey armoured aerial sentinel drone with a crimson optical visor, exposed sparking circuitry and venting steam.
Camera: stylised slow-motion orbit around the trio and the drone; one continuous shot, no cuts.
Action: In stylised slow motion the masked hero braces against the railing and pins the drone's limbs with two taut orange grapple cables; Penny pries up its shoulder armour with her wrench; Tomkin leaps and touches an exposed blue node with his bent ladle. Raindrops hang in the air around blue sparks.
No dialogue.
Sound: slowed-down rain, straining cables, metal prying, crackling blue sparks.
Audio: realistic sound effects and ambience only; spoken dialogue only as written above; no background music; no narrator.
extension_prompt:
Continue this exact shot seamlessly with the same camera move, the same characters (the masked hero, Penny, Tomkin, the armoured drone), identical costumes and props, the same setting, lighting and weather.
Action: The drone shudders and its crimson visor dims as the slow motion eases back to real time.
No dialogue.
Sound continues: slowed-down rain, straining cables, metal prying, crackling blue sparks.
